title: Show Generated File Disclaimer
description: When enabled, a disclaimer comment will be added at the top of the generated JSON file(s) as a _comment property

title: Token Name Style
description: The naming convention used for token keys in the JSON output

title: Token naming strategy
description: How to build each key from Supernova data: fullHierarchy = group path + parent group name + token name (default, matches Supernova export helpers); tokenOnly = token name only; supernovaPath = token.tokenPath only when set; supernovaPathAndName = tokenPath segments + token name; immediateParentAndToken = direct parent group + token name; fullGroupChainAndToken = all ancestor group names root-to-leaf + token name

title: Color Format
description: The format used for color values in the JSON output

title: Include Descriptions
description: When enabled, token descriptions will be included in the JSON output as a description property

title: Split by Token Type
description: When enabled, separate JSON files are generated per token type (e.g. color.json, typography.json). When disabled, a single tokens.json is produced

title: Length output (px / rem)
description: For spacing, sizing, typography dimensions, border width, blur radius, and shadow offsets: preserve uses the token's native unit (px, rem, %); px converts rem-based lengths to px; rem converts pixel-based lengths to rem using Rem root (px)

title: Rem root (px)
description: Assumed root font size in pixels when converting between px and rem (e.g. 16 means 1rem = 16px). Only used when Length output is px or rem.
